ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely high ratio favoring low-intensity pixels. Approximately 97% black (low intensity) to 3% white (high intensity) across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant solid black pigmentation across the entire surface. High-contrast white contiguous geometric clusters (spots) are localized at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes, with secondary sparse white pixel speckling across the mid-ventral regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated pixel angle of 115 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular jaggedness along the continuous boundary. Pronounced peaks and valleys are most concentrated on the inner halves of both lobes moving toward the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve along the trailing edge leading to sharply tapered and slightly upturned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially dense clusters of circular white pixel groups (barnacle scars) concentrated on the outer 5-10% of both fluke tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, near-vertical light-intensity linear marks visible on the mid-section of the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Ragged, irregular trailing edge on the far-right lobe tip suggesting minor tissue loss; significant white scarring clusters at both distal extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct, isolated white circular spots located in the lower central region near the peduncle attachment point.
